notes.title: Break down your Items
notes.content:
[h1]Break Down System[/h1]
We implemented the option to break down any items that you have in your inventory. When breaking down items, you gain Crystals. The amount of Crystals depends on the rarity.
[list]
[*] Common - 10
[*] Rare - 100
[*] Epic - 300
[*] Legendary - 500 
[/list]
It is possible to multi select items and use buttons to quickly select all items of a specific type or rarity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44155431/d0895bc41a1f6100e7e1357d299df78a989783a7.png[/img]

[h1]General Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed the UI layout to have a cohesive theme
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed achievement "The whole Arsenal", the game now checks on startup how many turrets you have unlocked and will unlock the achievement retroactively.
[*] Fixed the spent points in the stage selection not being distributed as visualized inside the run
[/list]

[h1]Tips[/h1]
[h3]Rewards[/h3]
If you are struggling with currency or rewards, make sure you "Take Rewards" after finishing a stage. If you do not take the rewards, but end up dying to the enemies, you only get a small fraction of the rewards.
Weigh the risk and reward in every stage and make calculated decision.

[h3]Tutorial/Stuck[/h3]
We keep getting questions/requests that players are stuck in specific screens. Please check the whole screen for Pop-Ups with an OKAY button.
You need to complete the tutorial before being able to click anything else.

Especially in the stage selection, please scroll to the last available stage and then you should see the Pop-Up. If that is not the case, or you need any other help, please contact us via [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/bS39kD5BrW]Discord[/url][/b].

Here is an example of how this might look.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44155431/5704ed5fb68cd0bb560e6b48a143b486424b9a7a.png[/img]


Thank you for playing Crystal Tower Defense! We are looking forward to seeing your labyrinths and hear your feedback.

notes.title: Change Hearts System & Balancing
notes.content:
[h1]Heart System[/h1]
You now start each run with a maximum of [b]25 Hearts[/b]. Everytime you are under 25 Hearts and complete a stage, you [b]regain 1 Heart[/b].
This improves the early game and rewards you for completing stages without leaks as you can rebuild your Hearts Pool.

[h1]General Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed Tutorials to represent the new Heart System
[*] Added a Tutorial for when you lose the first time whilst being under Stage 9, to explain the mechanic of taking rewards
[*] Changed the Game Ended screen to make it more obvious you missed out on rewards
[*] Added Hover Text to armor & shield waves to explain the mechanic again
[*] Targeting System now focuses the enemy based on spawn values and not current values (HP, Speed)
[*] In a run, you can now see the armor & shield damage turrets do. Hover over the turret in the bottom bar, you now have two additional stats.
[*] Increased the time for error and info texts showing up in a run, to make them readable more easily
[/list]

[h1]Balancing Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Decreased the amount of armor & shield points enemies gain per stage
[*] Lowered the starting value of armor & shield points
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Not having an Enemy Type selected now focuses any enemy and not just normal ones
[*] Fixed the Tutorial for the Stage Selection, this can lead to you having to go through it again
[/list]

[h1]Tips[/h1]
[list]
[*] Use the number row 1-9 to select turrets
[*] Use TAB and Space to switch between the speeds or pause the game
[*] Use CTRL + 1-3 to upgrade turrets
[*] Use SHIFT + 1-9 to select abilities
[*] Press X to toggle between SELL and BUY mode
[/list]


If you have any feedback, want to share your maze or come hang out, join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/bS39kD5BrW]Discord[/url].

notes.title: New Maps, New Enemy Types, New Items, New Targeting System
notes.content:
[b]!This update will reset your current run![/b]
[b]!This update will reset your current run![/b]

[h1]New Maps[/h1]
Unlock three new maps. After reaching the required stage, the map theme gets put into a pool and randomly selected on starting a run.
[list]
[b][*] Forest - Stage 20
[*] Ice - Stage 40
[*] Hell - Stage  60[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44155431/61445c19402c2183dfd212711f2cd4f12b78dc35.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Enemy Types[/h1]
We introduced two new enemy types. This will improve the late game difficulty and leads to the use of more different turrets. These enemies can also appear from the start, once you start on higher difficulties.
[h2]Armor[/h2]
Enemies with armor take [b]60% reduced damage[/b] through normal attacks. To be able to penetrate the armor more efficiently, you need to equip the right upgrades. You can spot these enemies by their bronze shield bar and you can spot upcoming armor waves by the bronze color of the formation icon.
[h2]Shield[/h2]
Enemies with shields can only have [b]one of their shield bars broken at a time[/b], no matter how strong the attack. Upcoming waves with shield enemies will have their formation coloured in blue. Monsters of that wave have a second blue healthbar. Equip items to increase the number of shield bars you can break.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44155431/f216ccbfd93135604214d0564aceb45499d47cdd.png[/img]

[h1]New Items[/h1]
We introduced two new items, to help you combat the new enemy types.
[h2]Armor Damage[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44155431/e77b2f5251505c1a6e94af161186b4d94cd01b3c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44155431/ec0a0f077d5046506d1b5da7e7e8a90b7ca54889.png[/img][/url]
Equipping turrets with this item, increases their damage against armor. 
[h2]Shield Damage[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44155431/660380ad63e9b681b8115ace65bad0082a4568b5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44155431/669978520d4386b9851b59f88168642b1f10ff98.png[/img][/url]
Equipping turrets with this item, allows you to break multiple shield bars at once. One shield bar per 100%.

[h1]New Targeting System[/h1]
We improved the targeting system available to you. You can now no longer only switch between two options, but target specific enemies to pick out the most threatening target.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44155431/8f7cc4ec361cfac297755dc155c795627be3e826.png[/img]


[h1]General Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed how points are spent in the stage selection screen to have a more realistic difficulty scaling
[*] Selected turret/abilities are now highlighted
[*] Turrets not affordable are greyed out
[*] Increased zoom range to be able to view the whole map at once
[*] Improved tutorial highlighting
[*] Mouse camera movement doesn't deselect turret anymore
[*] Enemies that are slowed, have their crystals turn blue
[*] Added 15 handmade waves that spawn randomly throughout a playthrough
[/list]

[h1]Balancing Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Selling a turret gives back 50% of the gold spend on upgrades
[*] Decreased the gold you get back when selling a base turret to 50% of its cost
[*] Items received from lootboxes drop on the lower end of the rarity range
[*] Upgrading items now scales with the rarity, lower rarity receive a higher % gain than higher rarities.
[*] Buffed late game turrets to be viable around the stage you receive them, even without major upgrades
[/list]

[h3]Bombarding Battery[/h3]
[list]
[*] Splash Damage Falloff: 0.75 => 0.85
[/list]
[h3]Digging Defender[/h3]
[list]
[*] Damage: 150 => 250
[*] Range: 2.5 => 1.5
[/list]
[h3]Missile Matrix[/h3]
[list]
[*] Damage: 90 => 400
[/list]
[h3]Plasma Pulse[/h3]
[list]
[*] Time to max damage: 25s => 10s
[*] Damage: 62 => 60
[*] Range: 3.5 => 3
[/list]


Performance improvements and small bug fixes.

Feel free to drop by on our [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/bS39kD5BrW]Discord [/url][/b] to leave some feedback or ask questions.

notes.title: Español, Português, Italiano Language Support & Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:

With this update we added spanisch, portugese and italian localization to the game.
You can now choose between, [b]English, German and French, Spanisch, Protugese, Italian[/b].

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Switching between Ability and Turret Placement via Shortcuts breaking the placement system - it now switches between the Turret and Ability
[*] Fixed Achievement "The whole Arsenal" - Turret unlocks were counted multiple times, now only count once

[/list]

notes.title: Save/Reload Fix
notes.content:
[h2]Fixed Reloading & Saving[/h2]
[h3]We apologize for any trouble caused by the defect save & reload feature[/h3]

With this patch we have changed the reload & save feature...once again...this time for the last time.
The changes were necessary as we introduced bugs with it, e.g. not being able to save your inventory.

[b]In case you previously lost your progress, please contact us support@hotroofstudios.de[/b]
We should be able to get your progress back, as there are multiple back up systems in place for your inventory/meta progress.

If you do contact us, please include a .zip of "\AppData\LocalLow\HotRoofStudios\CrystalTowerDefense".


We improved our release testing with various cases, e.g. using saves you sent us to test out our migration system.
Thank you for cooperating and providing Logs/Save Files.

[/list]


Feel free to drop by on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/bS39kD5BrW]Discord[/url].

notes.title: More Bug Fixes & Slight Balance Adjustments
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed low FPS/lag leading to weird enemy behaviour
[*] Fixed bullets becoming too slow => Increased bullet speed proportional to enemy speed.
[*] Improved bullets circling enemies => Increased enemy/bullet hitbox, increased bullet speed
[*] Improved Blinking Boulder (the one that come from the green crystal enemy) => Now spawn in a smaller location and follow the path. If the enemy lands off path, tries to get back onto the path.
[*] Fixed Blinking Boulder circling the end portal
[*] Fixed Digging Defender range indicator
[*] Fixed Digging Defender animation to fit reload speed
[/list]
We implemented more logging to be able to better reproduce bugs and find them faster. If you run into any weird behaviour please contact us about it in Discord or Steam.

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Blinking Boulder has a low chance of becoming indestructible - we received some logs already and are investigating this. If you run into the problem, please contact us.
[*] Having very low reload time and a lot of turrets leads to lag - we have a list of changes that we need to work through, which will improve overall perfomance.
[/list]

[h2]Balance Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reload Buff Zones value divided by 2 - e.g. 10% => 5%
[*] Added a fixed turret min. reload time that is not depending on the added upgrades. This min. reload time can only be overwritten by the "Rage" ability
[/list]

[h3]Minimum Reload Time[/h3]
[list]
[*] Spinning Sentry - 0.02225
[*] Laser Lancer - 0.5
[*] Grenade Gun - 0.675
[*] Thundering Turret - 0.75
[*] Bombarding Battery - 1.2
[*] Digging Defender - 0.75
[*] Missile Matrix - 1.2
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you for your Feedback![/h1]

We appreciate everyone posting feedback and feature wishes in the Steam Forums and on [url=https://discord.com/invite/bS39kD5BrW]Discord[/url]. This allowed us to implement the first batch of Bug Fixes rather quickly.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed: Money counter updating too slow - updates without animation if there are too many changes
[*] Fixed: Enemies going off path in higher stages due to high speed - Turning speed now scales with enemy speed
[*] Fixed: Wave generation 41+ not working - Enemies needed to advance are now counted correctly and do not include baby enemies
[*] Fixed: Reload Speed going below 0 with certain upgrade combinations - Upgradeable only until the next upgrade would go below 0
[*] Fixed: Statistic cards only showing "Victory" even if the run was lost - Keep in mind you lose points once enemies breach, having 0 as your score is not a bug
[/list]

[h2]Open Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Open: Thundering Turret on low reload speed causes lag
[*] Open: Lag Spikes can cause enemies to teleport
[/list]

[h2]Current Feature Requests[/h2]
[list]
[*] Auto Skip + Auto Continue - Start new stages and skip wave timer automatically
[/list]

[h2]Generic Information[/h2]
General feedback we received towards the balancing of the game till now is, that reload time rules over all the other stats for the buff zones and as a general stat. Introducing the bug fix above with it not going negative might change this, so we will keep an eye on that.
Laser Lancer turns out to be an overly needed turrets to defeat high hp enemies. We will look at how this pans out once more people reach the late game and unlock all turrets. Small sneak peak, the turret at stage 45 is also intended to deal with high hp targets.



A small tip at the end.
[list]
[*] Select Turrets with the Number row
[*] Upgrade Turrets with CTRL + Number row
[*] Select Abilities with SHIFT + Number row
[*] Change between Sell/Buy Mode with X
[*] Change game speed with TAB
[*] Pause the game with SPACE
[/list]
Enjoy pushing through stage 40!

notes.title: Playtest over
notes.content:
Our Playtest, which started on 2023.06.02 ends today on the 2023.06.18.

During those two weeks we received various feedback on balance, gameplay features and quality of life improvements. 
Thank you for participating and sharing your thoughts with us, in the Steam Forum, our [b][url=https://discord.gg/bS39kD5BrW]Discord[/url][/b] or per direct message.

After evaluating the feedback during the Playtest, we set out for a [b]Release[/b] on the [b]2023.07.20[/b]!

We want to share with you some statistics of the playtest and a summary of the feedback as well as the way forward.

[h2]Statistics[/h2]
[list]
[*] Over [b]100 participants[/b]!
[*] [b]Highest score[/b] achieved was [b]324,520[/b]!
[*] [b]Highest stage[/b] reached was [b]45[/b]!
[/list]

[h2]Feedback[/h2]
During the two weeks we [b]released two patches[/b], addressing the most wished for features and fixed critical bugs, to make the player experience smoother.

You can read up on the patches here.
[list]
[*] [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2429530/view/3701442764475433431?l=english]Patch One: Balancing Changes & Bug Fixes[/url][/b]
[*] [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2429530/view/3701442764493126247?l=english]Patch Two: New Quality of Life Features and More[/url][/b]
[/list]

Things we are looking into and address in [b]future updates[/b]. 
Disclaimer: Not everything we list here will be changed if we and the community deem it to be OK as it is.
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] We noticed a lot of players spent a long time trying to beat Stage 21.
[*] Starting out from a higher difficulty to earn more rewards is very difficult if you haven't unlocked the "Grenade Gun" (Stage 25) turret yet.
[*] How many Lootboxes and Crystals you keep on death.
[*] How much of your Highscore is lost if enemies reach the end. This currently is a fixed number, the current plan is to add a multiplier depending on the stage you are in.
[*] Late game balancing of enemies and turret cards.
[*] Make Slow Turrets (AoE and Single Target), slow attribute upgradeable.
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] To make it easier for new players, we are going to implement more tutorials.
[*] Localization for German.
[*] Adding Shortcuts for turret upgrades.
[*] Bug fixes, as there is always one hiding under the carpet. Please report them in our [b][url=https://discord.gg/bS39kD5BrW]Discord[/url][/b] if you find one.
[/list]
[h3]Feature Ideas[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemies currently only vary in their three main attributes, speed, health, coin value. There are two enemies with abilities, but we don't want to spoil those here. We are currently playing with the idea of introducing special modifiers that then require a specific turret to counter (deal increased damage).
[*] To give removing rocks a reward, beside more space, giving them a random chance to spawn a buff zone was one of the ideas from you.
[*] Introduce new turret types that don't block the enemies path, like mines or traps.
[*] Challenge Runs in which you can participate against others (via Highscore, no direct competition) with a reward for the winners.
[/list]


We hope you enjoyed your time playing [b]Crystal Tower Defense[/b] and we will see you in the [b]full release[/b] on the [b]2023.07.20[/b]!

notes.title: New Quality of Life Features and More
notes.content:
With these we release our [b]second major patch[/b] during the playtest. Some of you might have noticed that there were patches in-between, without patch notes. Changes made through those will also be listed here.

If you haven't yet, there is still time till the [b]18.06.2023[/b] to [b]check out Crystal Tower Defense for free[/b] and give us your feedback in our Discord sever [b][url=https://discord.gg/bS39kD5BrW]here[/url][/b].

[h2]Gameplay Systems[/h2]
[h3]Path Preview[/h3]
[list]
[*]With this patch we introduce "[b]Path Preview[/b]". Before you finalize the turret/wall placement it will [b]show[/b] you the [b]new path[/b] your enemies are going to take.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44155431/843da048e02510e6dc28c0735e8ff0d3b9f0010d.gif[/img]
[h3]Bulk Selling[/h3]
[list]
[*]We introduced a new "[b]Bulk Selling[/b]" feature. You can now press "[b]X[/b]" or the [b]small coin icon[/b], to the right of your turret hotbar (Tip: you can choose your turrets with 1, 2, 3 etc.) to [b]switch[/b] between "[b]Sell Mode[/b]" and "[b]Build Mode[/b]". 
[*]"[b]Sell Mode[/b]" is indicated with a [b]red cursor[/b] and the [b]coin icon[/b] being [b]gold[/b]. Once in "Sell Mode" you can sell turrets/walls with a [b]simple click[/b] on them.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44155431/8b2a76fad7c150900464b594c1a1c97928ca7925.gif[/img]
[h3]Turret Unlocks[/h3]
[list]
[*]You can now [b]buy[/b] newly [b]unlocked turrets[/b] whilst being [b]inside a run[/b]. This is only possible whilst the unlock pop-up is up.
[*]Currently the needed crystals are tightly calculated with the stage in which you unlock the turrets, so you need to save up on crystals in previous runs.
[/list]

[i]We hope to hear your feedback on this feature and current turret prices. 
[/i]

[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added various hover/pop-up texts over icons and ui elements.
[/list]
[h3]Lootbox Scene[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added a UI element showing how many crystals you received whilst opening your lootboxes at the end.
[/list]

[h2]Audio[/h2]
[list]
[*]Increased the maximum possible audio.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed: Getting stuck in the Armory tutorial
[*]Fixed: Selling an obstacle 2x2 only sold a 1x1 space, blocking the path without an option to remove it
[*]Fixed: UI overflow in Steam Leaderboard (this can be found under Statistics => Highscore)
[*]Fixed: Unable to switch turrets whilst having one selected ("Build Mode"), without deselecting the current one

notes.title: Balancing Changes & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone trying out our playtest, [b]over 100 players[/b] registered for it! We also received a lot of feedback on gameplay systems and bugs. We implemented these changes and fixes over the course of various small updates the last few days.

Here is a summary of all the major changes and fixes.

[h2]Gameplay Systems[/h2]
[h3]Enemy Introduction/Adjustment[/h3]
[list]
[*][i]Before: New enemies got introduced every 5 stages.[/i]
[*]After: [b]New enemies[/b] get introduced [b]every 10 stages[/b] (e.g. 10, 20, 30...).
[*][i]Before: Boss stage spawned normal enemies and the boss.[/i]
[*]After: Boss stage only spawns the boss.
[*]After: Hitpoints and speed of various enemies has been adjusted.
[/list]
If you are [b]stuck on a stage[/b], try [b]upgrading [/b]your turret with your rewards in the [b]armory [/b]or buy [b]new turrets[/b]. You can always check the current highscore in the statistics screen, to see how you are holding up against others. The current record is 62,480 points.

[h3]Turret Unlocks[/h3]
[list]
[*][i]Before: New turrets got unlocked every 5 stages.[/i]
[*]After: [b]New turrets[/b] get unlocked [b]every 10 stages[/b] (e.g. 5, 15, 25). As this is alternating to the stages in which new enemies get introduced, it should be easier to fight against them, once you purchase your turrets in the armory.
[*]After: The cost of unlocking new turrets and their upgrade slots has been adjusted.
[*]After: You now unlock the first upgrade slot, 5 stages after you unlocked the turret (exception is the spinning sentry, first slot is unlocked from the start).
[/list]
[h3]Rewards on Loss[/h3]
[list]
[*][i]Before: Once you lost a run, all your gained Crystals and Lootboxes were gone.[/i]
[*]After: Half of your collected Crystals goes into inventory and half stays as contested rewards. This also allows you to remove obstacles during a run, even if you initially started it with 0 Crystals.
[*]After: Up to 20% of your contested Lootboxes are retrieved if you lose the run. To receive any Lootboxes once you lose, you need to have beat 5 Stages in your run. Once you beat 5 Stages, each Stages saves 2% of your Lootboxes, up to a total of 20%.
[/list]
[h3]Turret Buff and Debuff Zones[/h3]
[list]
[*][i]Before: Random Buff and Debuff Zones were created on map generation, ranging from -50% to +50%[/i]
[*]After: 2 Buff and 2 Debuff Zones are created once you start from a higher Stage (e.g. 5, 10, ...). The percentage inside the Buff and Debuff Zone now depends on the difficulty Stage you started in. E.g. if you choose to start from Stage 20, the Zones will show +20% and -20%.
[/list]
[h3]Various[/h3]
[list]
[*]When you start from a higher Stage, you now start with more money. You gain an additional 5 coins per stage you start higher. E.g. if you choose to start from Stage 10, you have 35 (base) + 10 * 5 (additional coins) = 85 coins.
[/list]

[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added various hover/pop-up texts over icons and ui elements
[*]Now shows all attributes of turrets, even the ones that can't be upgraded
[*]When the game is paused, shows the current enemy modifier and your inventory, including contested rewards.
[*]Added default UI Scale for certain resolutions. If your UI is too small or too big, you can change it in the settings.
[/list]

[h2]Audio[/h2]
[list]
[*]Changed the audio mixing to make all sounds hearable
[*]Lowered overall loudness
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed: Enemy out of bounds
[*]Fixed: Save file corrupted after closing the game
[*]Fixed: Double clicking ESC stops the camera from being able to move
[*]Fixed: Forge Tutorial highlighted the wrong UI element
[*]Fixed: Loading the same saved game multiple times caused the enemies to disappear
[*]Fixed: Starting from a higher difficulty cause the enemy buffs to decrease for a certain number of stages instead of increase
[*]Fixed: Unable to switch Game Speed with TAB or Pause with SPACE
[*]Fixed: ESC not working inside Turret Equipment Scene
[*]Fixed: Enemy disappearing after reloading the same run multiple times
[/list]


We hope you are enjoying the playtest, if you do, set Crystal Tower Defense on your wishlist and follow it, to be notified about future updates and playtests.
See you in the next Patch Notes.

notes.title: Crystal Tower Defense - Feature List
notes.content:
Crystal Tower Defense is, as the name says, an upcoming Tower Defense Game.

[h1]Main Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Create your own labyrinth on a [b]randomly generated map[/b], using [b]10 unlockable turrets[/b] and walls.
[*]Defeat various enemies and fight [b]bosses[/b], in a combination of [b]hand-crafted[/b] and random [b]waves[/b].
[*][b]Enless waves[/b] of enemies, that get stronger each time.
[*][b]Rougelike elements[/b], lose all your rewards once your health reaches zero, gather [b]permanent upgrades[/b] for your turrets
[*][b]Combine upgrades[/b] inside the forge, to craft even better ones.
[*][b]Save your run[/b] and come back later.
[*][b]Speed up[/b] your game to go through each stage even faster
[*]Compete in a [b]leaderboard[/b] for the best playthrough.
[*]Unlock [b]achivements[/b].
[/list]
